notes.title: Lunaraxia Exhibits at BIC!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, this is our first post on Steam. :P[/p][p][/p][h2][b]BIC (Busan Indie Connect Festival)[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629127/f98269b672c57d1152b5f160f6fe7120029868df.png"][/img][/p][p]We are pleased (and a little late) to announce that we are exhibiting at BIC, which will be one of the first chance to [b]play our game![/b] BIC has both [b]online and offline[/b] exhibitions, and you can [url="https://bicfest.org"]get tickets[/url] at discounted price until [b]Jul. 27 (KST) [/b]so please do check it out![/p][p]BIC also has a [url="https://x.com/IronDeerGames/status/1946759969161748863"]Twitter RT event[/url] going on that [b]has a chance[/b] to land you a free ticket, effective until [b]Jul. 25 KST[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]BIC Online Exhibition:[/b] [b]Aug. 8 ~ Aug. 29 (KST)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]BIC Offline Exhibition: Aug. 15 ~ Aug. 17 (KST)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We also have plans to exhibit at [b]Tokyo Game Show [/b]later this year![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Development Update[/b][/h2][p]First of all, thank you all for following our game's development progress.[/p][p]It has been a busy month or two (time's flow eludes us at this point) since we opened our Steam Page, and a lot has been done since then.[/p][p]Most importantly, [b]UI and control scheme have been reworked[/b] to facilitate seamless gameplay based on initial playtest feedbacks, and we added [b]some artistic flourish to UI[/b] while at it too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629127/b7648e0fe84200f38c5715858457f009afd19d18.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629127/e4bbca00faae75b077a7cc74996e0efc948248a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also added [b]Cinematic Sequence[/b] to set the narrative tone of the game, and added [b]difficulty options[/b].[/p][previewyoutube="14TY6Txvl_4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hope you guys enjoy the additions and changes we have made.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629127/8c6c9bb183cb2a4b0b295b52c7827657677802f1.png"][/img][/p]
